svg.title: RecastPress 03 ブリックレッド
svg.desc: A standard Roman serif R with both feet touching the circular band, a tapered hanging stream separated from the letter, and one circular cut finished with square pixels clipped to the original glyph.
svg.metadata: Typeface: Times New Roman Regular with a 6-unit outline weight increase. Cut center: 181.802,181.802; radius: 300. Center lies at the outer circumference at 10:30, 45 degrees counterclockwise from top. Pixel cell: 10. Pixel band: 40. Boundary is a luminance mask on the original glyph; no white boundary pixels can exceed its fill.
